chapter: This Is Your Life and film work
title: Restoring her film of the show
summary: She treasures the film of the broadcast and Willard urges her to have it restored.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: That's great. I didn't realize that. I wish I had seen it. I missed that.
Well, some of these days maybe we'll get to do the film. I've got a -- I treasure that film, you know.
You probably shouldn't try to look at it until you've taken it to be restored. Those things disintegrate, you know.

Yes, I know they do, and I was talking -- I talked to someone not long ago, and they told me they would help me to get it, because the last time we tried to do it, use it you know, parts of it were broken off, and I really don't want that to happen.
It's a kinescope, is that what it is, or is it on film?
It's on film. It's on film.
There are places that just restore, so you can have it transferred to a video cassette or onto new film.
Well, I must do this, and no doubt even NBC, I'm sure probably they could even --
